name: Ľubica Karvašová - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the stocktaking of the European elections 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the 2024 European elections went and what should change before the next ones in 2029. It wants common EU rules for voting, including one voting day and the same minimum voting age. It asks for better information for voters, action against disinformation and foreign interference, and more effort to help young people, minorities and people with disabilities take part. This is an opinion; it does not change any law by itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for new EU election rules and better enforcement of existing ones.
- **Who it affects:** Voters, candidates, national parties and online platforms across all 27 member states.
- **What happens next:** EU governments must agree to any new election law. Parliament urges them to act quickly.
